summary: Eleven-metre kerb at a junction mouth on a through road; too short for a van.
reasons: Only 11 m, shorter than a van
Junction mouth on a through road
No cars parked at the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15-18 m away and more within 25 m; exposed at the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The stretch is 11 m and ends at the junction crossing; the lane has no pull-off, so a van cannot stop clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a signalised-style junction and crossing.
drivers.convention: No parked cars here. Sign nearby is 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm on Frederick Street, resident permits excepted.

sun_shade: Trees on the south verge shade the kerb from the south and west.
cannot_judge: Signs on site beyond the listed one
